What changed for users in each STARR-OMOP v5.4 dataset release, newest first and grouped by year and month. Each release is a dated, immutable snapshot; [Released Datasets](released_datasets.qmd) lists its dataset names. To find the releases that changed a table or field, search the site for its name.

- **2026:** [September](#release-2026-09-10)

# 2026 {#year-2026}

## September 2026 {#release-2026-09-10}

Snapshot cut on **September 10, 2026** (`_2026_09_10`). Dataset names are on [Released Datasets](released_datasets.qmd).

### Lab result values that were previously available only as free text now also provide a parsed comparison operator, numeric value, and unit {#star-12810}

**What changed**

Numeric lab results that were previously available only as free text (for example
`>10 mg`) now also come with ready-to-use parts: a comparison operator, a number,
and a unit. You no longer have to parse the text yourself to filter or aggregate on
the numeric value.

**Who is affected**

- STARR OMOP 5.4
- STARR Common

**Action required**

None. The original text value is unchanged; the new fields are additional.

**Docs to extract**

The same parsed values appear in two places — as new fields in STARR Common, and as
standard OMOP fields in STARR OMOP 5.4.

STARR Common — new fields on the SHC and LPCH lab result tables:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `operator_parsed_from_text_result` | Comparison operator when the result has one (`>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `=`); empty otherwise |
| `number_parsed_from_text_result` | The numeric value from the result |
| `unit_parsed_from_text_result` | The unit of measure when the result has one |

STARR OMOP 5.4 — standard `measurement` fields now populated from the parsed values:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value_as_number` | The numeric value (when the source did not already provide a structured number) |
| `operator_concept_id` | Standard concept for the comparison operator |
| `unit_source_value` | The unit text from the result |
| `unit_concept_id` | Standard concept mapped from that unit |
| `value_source_value` | The original result text (unchanged) |

**Example (illustrative, PHI-free)**

STARR Common (SHC / LPCH lab result tables):

| Result value | Operator | Number | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `123` | | `123` | |
| `10 mg` | | `10` | `mg` |
| `>10` | `>` | `10` | |
| `<=0.5` | `<=` | `0.5` | |
| `1,234.56 mg` | | `1234.56` | `mg` |

STARR OMOP 5.4 (`measurement`): the same values populate the standard fields
(`operator_concept_id` holds the standard concept for the operator symbol shown):

| `value_source_value` | `value_as_number` | `operator_concept_id` | `unit_source_value` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `123` | `123` | | |
| `10 mg` | `10` | | `mg` |
| `>10` | `10` | concept for `>` | |
| `<=0.5` | `0.5` | concept for `<=` | |
| `1,234.56 mg` | `1234.56` | | `mg` |
